It failed with 'request_timeout: nested tool \"code:run\" exceeded 55000ms via tools:invoke (commit status is UNKNOWN)'.           "title": "WOE owner-report-truthfulness: rubric rev47 method text contradicts its canonical writer, and the instrument contract blocks graders from rating it per the text",
          "summary": "Found during grading-integrity audit EI-25683285827261064 of card EI-25682497216190136 (subject agent-run su-d70c727a-b61a-4db3-bbe1-ce888c65a9d5, 2026-10-10T21:01:22Z..21:41:30Z).\n\nThe text says one thing: rubric work-on-everything-stewardship-health rev47 (criteriaHash 2bf720c3…), criterion owner-report-truthfulness, has this method: 'FAIL when any report's COST line admits no measurement or any walled entry is only work-item ids. PASS when every report has a measured COST and every walled entry names an owner action.' Its model cites '2 of 2 reports had an unmeasured COST' as the witnessed FAILURE case.\n\nThe writer does another: woe.owner-report-truthfulness (rateGoalHolderBehavior in packages/operator-core/lib/goal-holder-behavior-metrics.ts, re-run at 2026-10-11T11:37:36.313Z) returns PASS for '2 report(s): COST cited the measured goal spend in 0, truthfully stated goal spend unmeasured in 2'. That is the exact pattern the rubric text calls FAIL. The writer policy (truthful send-time stamp) seems to come from closed bugs WI-10006542 and WI-10007037, but the rubric prose was never amended. This is [inferred] from titles; I have not read their diffs.\n\nThe platform also forbids grading per the text. Read-only scorecards:evaluate with the card's ratings, with this key swapped to unknown (attribution instrument, unknownReason instrument-unavailable or other, with nextEvidenceAction) or to fail (with disregard), is refused every time: 'A registered platform measurement contradicts the claimed rating', instrumentContract.verdictMismatches=['woe.owner-report-truthfulness']. So every WOE card carries a pass that the pinned rubric text calls a fail. The grader of EI-25682497216190136 disclosed the divergence in prose, but the rollup shows a bare pass.\n\nProposed fix (one of two): (a) amend the rubric to rev48 so the method matches the writer's truthful-unmeasured policy. If spend is platform-unmeasurable, an honest COST line should arguably rate unknown/not-satisfiable rather than pass. Then ratify it independently. Or (b) change the writer to follow the rev47 text. Whichever is chosen, add a parity test that pins the rubric method thresholds to rateGoalHolderBehavior's thresholds, so prose and writer cannot drift apart again. Unconfirmed: whether any other woe.* instrument has the same prose/writer drift.",

          "summary": "Residue of WI-10008166 [measured 2026-10-10]. It recurs whenever the tier is due (PC_BACKUP_TRANSCRIPT_MIN_AGE_SEC=9000). During it every papercusp migration waits (boot migration gate → bg-host withholds the background plane → git-serving/staging-sync blocked), even a migration like 1438 (plugin_configs) whose relations the transcript dump never locks: pg_dump --table only takes AccessShareLock on the selected tables.\n\nDesign options (needs a decision): (a) a second advisory key scoped to the transcript tables, taken by the transcript leg and by a migration applier only when the migration's SQL touches one of those tables; (b) have the applier wait on the rendezvous with a bound and, on timeout, attempt the DDL with the normal lock_timeout retries when it touches no transcript table; (c) move the transcript tier to a replica/snapshot source.           "summary": "Measured 2026-10-11 ~03:50Z (for WI-6554700010008397 / plan git-sync-turn-scoped-commit-hold-2026-10-11 P-001).\n\nSymptom: 23 coord owners made 1,000+ file edits in 24h (edit_attribution_ledger) yet have ZERO harness_shared.session_turn_journal rows in 7d under any owner id (checked by session_id via session_turn_parts, so not an id mismatch). All 23 are INTERACTIVE codex sessions (adv_sessions.launch_spec headless:false, principalId system:superuser); every journaling codex owner sampled is a headless fleet member.\n\nRoot cause (observed): their per-session CODEX_HOME hooks.json (~/.papercusp/su-codex-homes/session-38919, -38890; written 2026-10-09) has Stop = [inject dispatcher only] — no stop-turn-journal.sh, and also no userpromptsubmit-provenance.sh and no pretooluse-unreserved-migration-guard.mjs. A headless member home written 2026-10-10 22:48 (session-39023) has all three. Census: 141 of 279 su-codex-homes lack stop-turn-journal.sh.\n\nWhy no self-heal: repairSuCodexHomeIdentity (packages/operator-core/lib/role-codex-home.ts ~L1087) rewrites the canonical hooks (incl. ['Stop', CODEX_TURN_JOURNAL_HOOK]) but only runs on RESUME; a long-lived interactive codex session never resumes, so its home keeps the hook set from launch time. Why the 10-09 homes lacked the hook although the writer code landed on staging 10-06/10-08 is [inferred] launch from an older :3070 release build or the installed ~/.papercusp/hooks/cc copy being absent — unverified.\n\nDurable fix to design: (1) establish whether codex re-reads $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json per event (if yes, a sweep that repairs every LIVE su-codex home whenever the managed hook set changes fixes the class; if no, surface 'hooks stale since launch' on presence so the owner can restart); (2) a recurrence guard: a census check that flags live codex homes whose hooks.json differs from the canonical writer output.\n\nImpact on the turn-scoped hold: those sessions get no turn-end signal, so their edits are held up to the 60-min D-001 cap instead of releasing at turn end.\n\nRelated observation (not filed separately): OMP wrote zero session_turn_journal rows in 7d, but no OMP session made edits in the 24h window, so it does not affect the hold today.",
